title: Brandon Fugal: Skinwalker Ranch phenomenon is reflective

tellings.quote: Uh Brandon Fugal uses it when he goes to Skinwalker Ranch. He says clearly >> the phenomena is reflective.

plain: Whatever happens at Skinwalker Ranch, a Utah property known for reports of strange events, is said to be 'reflective', mirroring the people who go there. The UFO researcher Grant Cameron says this view comes from Brandon Fugal, the businessman who owns the ranch, who uses the idea when he visits. If true, the phenomenon would respond to its observers rather than act on its own.
